name: Pemulihan status tidak dikenal dan receipt parsial
scope: isolated synthetic workspaces; only main planner activation
acceptance: Unknown/missing/retrying operation states remain uncertain; success:true or unrelated read does not resolve them.
Partial/truncated execution receipts cannot verify completion, including positive test counts and terminal job labels.
Whole-file write with partial acknowledgement is reconciled by exact matching full readback without resubmission when no async operation reference exists.
Preserve scope, revision, protected assertions, Data Firewall and ordinary synchronous Cline compatibility.
privacy: technical hashes, enums and counts only; no user chat, customer data or credentials
activation: same-source full regression + 12 model missions + 3 native Cline regressions; idle/CAS/backup, only harmonika-ai restart
